Maya (Product): Hey @PeopleOps — quick q about coming back from parental leave in July. Hoping to do a gradual return: 3 days/week onsite, 2 days remote for first 8 weeks. Any implications for benefits/payroll? also childcare stipend start date? thx
Anna (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: We can support phased returns. A few things to flag quickly: benefits (health/dental) stay active during leave if you were enrolled before leave; payroll/proration depends on FTE and exempt status. Can you DM me your leave start/end dates and whether you'll be salaried or hourly?
Maya (Product): I'm salaried, was full-time, leave started 2025-12-15 and ending 2026-06-30. Plan to return 2026-07-06 part-time 60% (3/5).
Anna (People Ops): Ok — short answers: 1) benefits: remain active while you are on company-approved leave and through your documented return if there's no employment break. If leave is unpaid beyond the policy window we may need to do COBRA-like steps. 2) payroll: we'll update your FTE in Workday for the phased-return period which handles salary proration and benefit deductions. 3) childcare stipend: processed on first payroll after return once the childcare form is approved and receipts/contract are submitted. Link to form: https://hr.internal/forms/childcare-stipend (internal). 4) please submit the 'Phased Return' form in the HR portal — that creates the manager approval workflow and the official schedule.
Kevin (Eng): cc @Julia — for oncall/rotation planning we should reduce your oncall load for the first 2 cycles. We can also schedule overlap handoffs.
Julia (Manager): Yup, we can reassign oncall and shift deliverables. Maya — please add preferred handoff days in the phased-return form and I will approve it. We're fine with 60% for 8 weeks and then re-eval.
Maya (Product): Thanks! Do I need to re-enroll or change benefits elections before return? Also will stock vesting/holiday accrual change if I'm 60%?
Anna (People Ops): Good Q — equity vesting continues per the equity plan; payroll shows continued vesting unless there's an interruption of service. Holiday/accruals: PTO accrual is prorated for FTE < 1. We'll run an accrual estimate for you after the Workday FTE change is queued. If you want, I can run numbers for the 8-week period.
Payroll Bot: Automated notice: To change FTE, submit a 'Comp/FTE change' request in Workday at least 5 business days before your return date. Workday link: https://workday.internal/tickets
Maya (Product): I'll submit the forms today. Who signs the childcare stipend form? manager or people ops?
Anna (People Ops): Manager approves the phased return schedule; People Ops processes the childcare stipend once the form + receipts/contract are uploaded. For the stipend we need: proof of childcare (invoice or contract) dated within the first 30 days of return.
Kevin (Eng): If helpful, we can schedule 2 overlap days with your backup the first week back so handoffs are smooth. @Maya let me know which week you'd like that.
Maya (Product): That'd be great — maybe week of 7/6. Also is there an intermittent leave flex option if I need extra days?
Anna (People Ops): Yes — managers can approve intermittent leave/accommodations for short-term needs. Submit a short-term accommodation request in the portal and we'll document paid vs unpaid days depending on your eligibility.
Julia (Manager): We'll be flexible on scheduling. Want to do a welcome-back planning call Thursday 11am to align expectations?
Maya (Product): Works for me. I submitted the phased-return + childcare form. Thanks everyone :heart:
